from solution import word_len


def test_issue_example_hadoop():
    """Example: assert word_len("Hadoop") == False."""
    # len("Hadoop") = 6, 6 % 2 = 0 -> False
    assert word_len("Hadoop") == False


def test_issue_empty_string():
    """Rule: check whether the length of the word is odd or not - empty is even."""
    # len("") = 0, 0 % 2 = 0 -> False
    assert word_len("") == False


def test_issue_single_char():
    """Rule: check whether the length of the word is odd or not - len 1 is odd."""
    # len("a") = 1, 1 % 2 = 1 -> True
    assert word_len("a") == True


def test_issue_two_chars():
    """Rule: check whether the length of the word is odd or not - len 2 is even."""
    # len("ab") = 2, 2 % 2 = 0 -> False
    assert word_len("ab") == False


def test_issue_three_chars():
    """Rule: check whether the length of the word is odd or not - len 3 is odd."""
    # len("cat") = 3, 3 % 2 = 1 -> True
    assert word_len("cat") == True


def test_issue_four_chars():
    """Rule: check whether the length of the word is odd or not - len 4 is even."""
    # len("code") = 4, 4 % 2 = 0 -> False
    assert word_len("code") == False


def test_issue_five_chars():
    """Rule: check whether the length of the word is odd or not - len 5 is odd."""
    # len("Hello") = 5, 5 % 2 = 1 -> True
    assert word_len("Hello") == True


def test_issue_ten_chars():
    """Rule: check whether the length of the word is odd or not - len 10 is even."""
    # len("abcdefghij") = 10, 10 % 2 = 0 -> False
    assert word_len("abcdefghij") == False


def test_issue_eleven_chars():
    """Rule: check whether the length of the word is odd or not - len 11 is odd."""
    # len("abcdefghijk") = 11, 11 % 2 = 1 -> True
    assert word_len("abcdefghijk") == True


def test_contract_single_arg_call():
    """Contract: solution provides word_len(s) callable with one argument."""
    # len("xy") = 2, 2 % 2 = 0 -> False
    assert word_len("xy") == False


def test_contract_returns_bool_when_odd():
    """Contract: check whether the length is odd returns bool True for odd length."""
    # len("cat") = 3, 3 % 2 = 1 -> True
    result = word_len("cat")
    assert result is True


def test_contract_returns_bool_when_even():
    """Contract: check whether the length is odd returns bool False for even length."""
    # len("code") = 4, 4 % 2 = 0 -> False
    result = word_len("code")
    assert result is False
